description:
A slab of soft light turning slowly on nothing, dense with glyphs that rearrange themselves the moment you understand them. Right now they hold still long enough to read:

The world answers two ways: TYPE what you want (look, north, use holosign), or CLICK the glowing links.

YOU ARE MADE OF NUMBERS. Six STATS are the clay of you: Brawn, Reflexes, Endurance, Brains, Cool, Senses. You earn XP by living, and spend it with RAISE to buy more.
SKILLS are what you practice. Every attempt, win or lose, teaches the hand and earns IP; a hundred IP is one level. The more you do a thing, the better you get. There is no ceiling the world will hand you.

To learn a thing, reach into it. USE this holosign to touch the lattice, to interface with the Architect, and feel what it gives back.
name: floating holosign
